patthana22.25:1.1: na ajjhattaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhā hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.25:2.1: na bahiddhā na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhatto hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.25:3.1: hetuyā dve. naajjhattārammaṇattika nahetuduke ajjhattārammaṇattika hetudukaṃ
patthana22.25:4.1: na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ajjhattārammaṇo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: dve.
patthana22.25:5.1: na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bahiddhārammaṇo hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.25:6.1: hetuyā cha. nasanidassanattika nahetuduke sanidassanattika hetudukaṃ
